name: FLIXO Agent blocks execution confirmation when no image is attached
description: The Agent must require an image before executing an already prepared plan.

planSteps.description: Enter `compress this image under 200KB and convert to WebP` in the FLIXO Agent command field
Verify the plan-ready card is visible
Enter `execute` in the command field and send the message
Verify the Agent reports that an image is required before execution
Verify no result preview is displayed
